main:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Reads n, m, an array a, and m union operations; after computing component minima, it prints 0 for one component, Impossible when too many components, the total array sum for the exact bound, or the sum of component minima plus the smallest remaining array values after sorting." main]
    [INPUTS]
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Read two integers from standard input into n and m using scanf("%d%d", &n, &m). RESULT n_m_read]
            [COMMAND Allocate integer arrays uni and a of length n, and declare x, y, and t for union processing. RESULT arrays_allocated]
            [COMMAND For i = 0; i < n; ++i, read one integer into a[i] using scanf("%d", &a[i]). RESULT a_loaded]
            [COMMAND For i = 0; i < n; ++i, set uni[i] = i. RESULT uni_initialized]
            [COMMAND For i = 0; i < m; ++i: read two integers into x and y using scanf("%d%d", &x, &y). If uni[x] != x: set t = uni[y], set uni[y] = x, find the root j by starting with j = y and repeatedly assigning j = uni[j] while uni[j] != j, then set uni[y] = j; next, for j = 0; j < n; ++j, if j != y and uni[j] == t, set uni[j] = uni[y]. Otherwise: set t = uni[x], set uni[x] = y, find the root j by starting with j = x and repeatedly assigning j = uni[j] while uni[j] != j, then set uni[x] = j; next, for j = 0; j < n; ++j, if j != x and uni[j] == t, set uni[j] = uni[x]. RESULT union_ops_processed]
            [COMMAND Initialize num = 0. For i = 0; i < n; ++i, if uni[i] == i, increment num. RESULT num_components]
            [COMMAND If num == 1, print "0" to standard output and return 0 from the current function. RESULT single_component_output]
            [COMMAND If num * 2 - 2 > n, print "Impossible" to standard output and return 0 from the current function. RESULT impossible_output]
            [COMMAND If num * 2 - 2 == n, initialize t = 0; for i = 0; i < n; ++i add a[i] to t; print t using printf("%d", t); then return 0 from the current function. RESULT exact_bound_output]
            [COMMAND Allocate integer arrays min and minn of length n. For i = 0; i < n; ++i, set min[i] = inf. RESULT min_initialized]
            [COMMAND For i = 0; i < n; ++i, if min[uni[i]] > a[i], set minn[uni[i]] = i and min[uni[i]] = a[i]. RESULT component_minima_found]
            [COMMAND Set ssum = 0 as a long long value and tnum = num - 2. RESULT accumulator_initialized]
            [COMMAND For i = 0; i < n; ++i, create local variable y = inf; if min[i] != y, add (long long)min[i] to ssum and set a[minn[i]] = inf. RESULT component_minima_summed]
            [COMMAND Sort array a in place using qsort(a, n, sizeof(int), compare). RESULT a_sorted]
            [COMMAND For i = 0; i < tnum; ++i, add a[i] to ssum. RESULT extra_minima_added]
            [COMMAND Print ssum to standard output using printf("%lld", ssum) and return 0 from the current function. RESULT final_output]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
